title: Make worktree verification subprocess checks sandbox-compatible
description: The required npm run verify:worktree and full suite cannot complete in the managed sandbox because hidden-Unicode and CLI tests use child_process spawnSync, while Codex MCP tests bind loopback; each fails with EPERM even though focused engine tests pass. Review whether CI/agent verification needs an environment-compatible path.
notes:
Implemented restricted verification mode: npm run verify:worktree:sandbox passes ESHYRA_TEST_SANDBOX=1 to child checks; subprocess/loopback integration tests skip only in that mode. Added policy coverage and AGENTS.md guidance. Full sandbox verification passed (4678 passed, 29 skipped); default targeted capability tests passed 35/35.
Addressed PR #465 review: narrowed sandbox eligibility to environments where Git/npm orchestration works but known nested Node/npm and loopback operations fail; preserved the qualified alternative in the mandatory pre-push rule; corrected CLI test comments; added policy assertions. Full npm run verify:worktree passed (4688 passed, 19 skipped).
close_reason: Implemented and opened PR #465 with restricted sandbox verification mode.
